name: com.coralogix/mcp-server
title: Coralogix
description: Query logs, metrics, traces, dashboards and alerts on the Coralogix platform.

region.description: Your Coralogix region. Find it in the URL of your Coralogix UI, or see docs/regions.md.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <personal API key>. Omit this header to use OAuth 2.1, which is the recommended flow and requires no manual configuration.

headers.name: x-allow-costly-use
headers.description: Set to 'true' to expose the Olly AI agent tools, which consume Olly quota. Omitted by default.

headers.name: mcp-version
headers.description: Pins the tool surface. Defaults to v2. Use v1 only for legacy integrations.
